title: url-linkfeed GET request decodes cleanly, response is result.link array

source.name: ortbtools url-linkfeed URL-request decoder contract (packages/core/decoders/request/url-linkfeed/index.js) and the paired Link-Feed response validator (packages/core/rules-feed.js validateLinkFeed) — the product's own documented, host-agnostic GET request/response shape (path /link, format=json+feed+auth), not a named vendor's public documentation page
source.version: repo HEAD at session start, commit a61fc25
source.license: Internal product code (ortbtools); no third-party material copied. MIT for the original fixture values.
source.notes: The decoder is deliberately host-agnostic (recognized by path+params, never by hostname) per the decoder registry's own stated policy; the exact field list documented here traces to an in-repo operational shape (CHANGELOG.md records the field list as derived from real partner-integration samples, not a public vendor doc page) and is cited here as the product's own contract, not as a public vendor source.

modifications: All ids, tokens, prices, IPs and destination URLs independently authored.
feed.example.test is a reserved .test host; device.ip uses TEST-NET 192.0.2.44; feed/auth tokens and subid are clearly synthetic fixture strings.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor, publisher or subscriber data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; feed/auth/subid values are synthetic-fixture strings; the host is a reserved .test name.

pairApplicability.note: A GET/JSON feed pair, not an oRTB auction — the URL request decodes to a canonical GET request and the JSON response is the documented result.link wire shape for that decoder; crosscheck does not apply (string request, no oRTB seatbid pairing).

specNotes: packages/core/decoders/request/url-linkfeed/index.js requires exactly: path /link (case-insensitive, trailing-slash tolerant) and query params format=json AND feed AND auth present (no `query` param requirement, unlike the sibling search-feed decoder) — every required param is present here with a plausible value, so decode must succeed with canonical.format='pops' and zero request findings.

The decoded canonical request also maps optional params: device.ip from user_ip, device.ua from ua, device.language from lang, site.page from url, user.id from subid — all present here, none malformed, so request.url.* findings (insecure_http, ch_field_empty, etc.) must not fire.

The response shape `{result:{link:[{bid,url,seat}]}}` is the exact documented wire response for this decoder (packages/core/decoders/request/url-linkfeed/index.js file header, line 26-28) and validates via packages/core/rules-feed.js validateLinkFeed: url required (present), bid required numeric>0 (present, 0.27), seat recommended (present) — zero findings.

detectFormat's hasPopBidCollectionShape test (format-detect.js) tags FORMATS.POPS on both the decoded request (canonical.format='pops') and the result.link row shape (url+bid present) — both sides agree.

Preview: findAdm/findPushMaterial only recognize `adm`/`iurl` (oRTB shapes) or the push-material key set (cpc/price + click_url/link + a creative key); `result.link[].url` matches none of those, so the current preview shows the top-level empty state instead of the destination as inert text — see knownGap DEF-202, already recorded for the sibling pop-kadam-clickunder/pop-ppcmate/pop-adon3 cases and shared here for the same root cause.
Browser preview must not open a real popup or dispatch tracking.
notes: This request decodes cleanly end to end (no no_decoder gap) — unlike the sibling PPCmate/Adon3/Kadam feed cases, which pair a documented vendor GET shape that this product's decoder registry does not (yet) recognize.

preview.limitation: documented response wrapper is not recognized by the preview's creative-lookup walk
preview.capabilityGap: no inert-destination preview for this wrapper shape

knownGap.note: Documented response creatives retain their wire wrappers; a visible card or inert destination should be available, or absence reported as an unsupported preview capability.
